results.title: How To Detect AI-generated Fake Reviews On Amazon Electronics Pages Using Free Browser Extensions
results.snippet: Running multiple AI detectors simultaneously can trigger Amazon’s anti-bot scripts, causing temporary CAPTCHAs or review-loading failures. Open the product page and scroll to the “Customer Reviews” section. Click “See all reviews” to load the full list. Enable your chosen extension (e.g., ReviewSage). Wait 2–3 seconds for the overlay icons to appear next to each review. Filter for 4–5 star reviews—these are most commonly weaponized for AI fakes.
